title: Invis Death Message
description: A plugin that hides the identity invisible player killers in death messages.
body:
A plugin that hides the identity of invisible player killers in death messages.

When a player is killed by another player who has the invisibility potion
effect, the death message uses a obfuscated killer name and never includes the weapon name or damage type.

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e72bd70eb397601232f20ea60067109503af82ee.png)
